facts.claim: sandbox_backend is resolved once per run (via _resolve_sandbox_backend in get_task_processing_context.py) into TaskProcessingContext.sandbox_backend and persisted into TaskRun.state['sandbox_backend'] at provision time (sandbox_connection.py persist_sandbox_connection). It must be carried explicitly through continue_as_new (ResumedSandboxState.sandbox_backend) and restored into self._context.sandbox_backend on resume, because TaskProcessingContext is reloaded fresh via get_task_processing_context on every continuation and would otherwise re-resolve (defaulting to 'modal') rather than reusing the run's actual backend. TaskRun.prepare_for_cloud_resume() also explicitly pops state['sandbox_backend'] so a new cloud resume re-resolves from scratch rather than inheriting a stale value.
